source_metadata: CurseForge official API; downloaded public author archives checked once against published file length and SHA1 at the download boundary. Archives and decompiled code are excluded from this repository.
limits: Source metadata, archive contents, JSON semantics, decompiled functional paths and targeted texture pixels were reviewed.
No Java26 engine, Bedrock runtime, BDS, world migration or human client acceptance was performed for this branch.
No runtime, release identity, baseline lock or installation change is made by these review documents.

The two 26.1.2 releases do not register crazy, respawn, double_damage, explosion, level_boost, continuous_heal or creative_flight; removed unused classes are not a removal from the maintained 1.21.1 gameplay baseline.

adaptation_items.delta: Metadata changes from 1.1.3 to 1.1.6 and changes the declared license; the required Minecraft, NeoForge and Tavern ranges remain unchanged.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Separate Minecraft branch; source identities are unchanged. License metadata is recorded without inferring permission to redistribute modified source or assets.

adaptation_items.delta: Registers custom luck and removes the registered bonemeal_spreader effect. Dassai Q3–Q6 uses custom luck amplifiers 1–4 for 80/240/720/2160 seconds. Each level gets a 25% float roll to reroll raw loot, up to five attempts; only previously absent item types are appended.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Minecraft 1.21.1 uses vanilla Luck. This custom algorithm must not be substituted into that baseline.

adaptation_items.delta: BlockDropsEvent copies the actual drop entities for crops and ores at min(0.15 + amplifier * 0.05, 1). Extra entities use the source default pickup delay; its Java26 engine value was not executed.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Minecraft 1.21.1 instead runs Block.getDrops independently from its block-break event. Preserve that reroll adapter; causal mob-drop collection remains a separate unfinished task.

adaptation_items.delta: Adds tonic water: water-potion component, sugar and vine produce one item. Cola also requires the water-potion component. Lava 1000 fluid units over 1800 ticks produces one obsidian instead of three magma blocks. The milk recipe uses minecraft:milk. Cabinet category edits leave the swapped spruce/dark-oak outputs unchanged.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Minecraft 1.21.1 already has tonic water and highball, and the current port uses its magma-block recipe. The 26.1.2 recipe and fluid changes require separate adaptation.

adaptation_items.delta: Adds custom Consumable sound initializers and a reusable bottled-mixer finish method. Use duration is 32 ticks. Cola applies speed and haste for 300 ticks; tonic applies regeneration for 300 ticks. All six original OGG samples are unchanged.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Minecraft 1.21.1 already has corresponding item/sound classes. Current float and single-item container repairs retain their 1.21.1 sources. Java26 Consumable timing and rendered cadence remain unverified.

adaptation_items.delta: Boating uses multiplier 1.3 + min(amplifier * 0.2, 1), speed cap 1.2 and braking factor 0.85. Reverse gravity uses tick HEAD, travel TAIL, jump HEAD and ceiling TAIL phases. Multi-jump uses positive Y velocity as falling under reverse gravity.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: These paths largely converge with the existing 1.21.1 source already targeted by current repairs. Native player collision, phase and client equivalence remain pending.

adaptation_items.delta: Adds a recursion marker, cancels the original damage, performs an owner-attributed 10000-damage attempt and uses the source blocked-damage fallback. Missing heads use exact class or registry candidates. Bosses are dragon, wither and warden.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Minecraft 1.21.1 already contains this author lifecycle. The port still has separate recursion, fallback and causal head/drop collection gaps.

adaptation_items.delta: Adds a two-slot cabinet transfer handler with one item per slot and whole-cabinet occupancy for irregular items. Comparator output is 3 for a single irregular item, otherwise 0–2 occupied slots.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Preserve current native-storage and migration repairs. Full transfer, comparator and multiplayer parity require their own checks.

adaptation_items.delta: Uses the NeoForge native milk fluid, persists MaxOutputCount and renders output height from count/max. Directional shape helpers replace explicit shapes. Extraction wrappers compose original tap behavior, and a Jade fluid tooltip is added.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Fluid identifiers, saved output ratios, shapes and interaction need separate 26.1.2 adaptation. No current world ownership or identity changes are authorized by this review.

adaptation_items.delta: Sixteen stools gain the host sittable tag, shared SitEntity at height 0.9, yaw and occupied-seat checks, destruction cleanup and source waterlogging.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Compare against the existing 1.21.1 seat adapter and native waterlogging. Java entity identity is not directly imported into Bedrock.

adaptation_items.delta: Adds the one-level accelerator, maximum quality 6, a 2400-tick book cooldown, main-hand and non-FakePlayer checks, source one-shot feedback and operator brew commands.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Minecraft 1.21.1 already has the accelerator source. Bedrock enchantment and operator-command parity remain unfinished; this review adds no experimental world flags.

adaptation_items.delta: Changes five cocktail models and adds gin-tonic, highball and tonic resources. Of 13 textures matched to current resource-pack paths, eight have equal decoded pixels and five differ. The new luck icon is unported. Creative filters and treasure-sense server/client rendering also change.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Pixel comparisons do not establish model or rendered parity. Differences from the 26.1.2 branch do not by themselves make current 1.21.1 source art obsolete.

adaptation_items.delta: The random disc comparator output changes from 5 to 6. Its nine-alcohol crafting recipe is unchanged.
adaptation_items.current_1_21_1_impact: Check the Minecraft 1.21.1 source before changing the port; keep this redstone change specific to 26.1.2.

current_reassessment.scope: Current maintained Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge author 1.1.11, file 9066406; public W119 source and the inherited W120 candidate. This reassessment supersedes historical current_1_21_1_impact statements for shared freezer recipe/height/fluid behavior only. The original review date, archive comparison and 26.1.2 deltas remain unchanged.

shared_behavior_already_implemented.current: Current FREEZER_RECIPES uses lava 1000 fluid units / 1800 ticks -> one obsidian. Three magma blocks exist only in LEGACY_FREEZER_RECIPES to retain previous saved outputs; they are not a newly selectable active recipe. Tonic/highball and source water-potion predicates already follow the maintained 1.21.1 baseline.

Current freezer result height uses source float count/maxCount ratio, capped at one, with .3125 + .3125 * ratio. Maintained minecraft:milk is explicitly mapped to the owned milk_still identity. These shared mechanics already exist; they are not an unimplemented Java26-only gap.

branch_specific_differences_remaining: 26.1.2 custom Luck amplifier/loot-attempt algorithm and removed bonemeal_spreader registration differ from maintained 1.21.1 vanilla Luck; no replacement or complete adaptation is claimed.
26.1.2 BlockDropsEvent copies actual drop entities; maintained 1.21.1 rerolls Block.getDrops. Mob-loot causality and native/client equivalence remain separate unfinished work.
The 26.1.2 effect registration set, platform fluids/interaction/rendering APIs and remaining source deltas still require branch-specific review; shared freezer parity does not close that branch.
